minutes.headline: Select Board approved the skate park site next to Kids Kingdom, discussed the social media policy, and held an economic development workshop.
minutes.summary: The board opened with the chair's apology over last week's comment and the DPW director's complaint about criticism from a selectman. It reviewed the social media policy without changing it, approved skate park option one, and signed warrants. A joint workshop with the Planning Board and Agricultural Commission on agriculture and economic development followed, ending with a plan to put an Economic Development Committee on a future agenda, then an executive session on non-union contract negotiations.

attendees.name_as_heard: Chair of the Board of Selectmen

public_comment.topic: Boys and Girls Club 'Are you smarter than a sixth-grader' fundraiser on April 13; thanks to the Charter Review Committee for its meeting.

The DPW director objected to a selectman's criticism at last week's meeting about stormwater and the debt exclusion, said his rights as an employee may have been violated, and cited a consultant's favorable view of the drainage system.
Skate park proposers asked about stipulations on size and scope and whether prevailing wage applies.
Civil engineer asked permission to put a survey crew on the skate park site; told it is the town manager's responsibility.
Social media policy should not stop private citizens who volunteer for the town from sharing knowledge as private citizens.
DPW storm updates on Facebook drew positive feedback; asked for an exception to the social media policy.
Resident supported keeping farms and open space viable, framing town support as an investment.
Farm family member supported outreach to farmers on agriculture-related economic development.

votes.motion: Approve skate park option one, the land east of Kids Kingdom, while allowing for future parking for the TC Passios building.
Enter executive session under Chapter 30A section 21 reason 2, contract negotiations with non-union personnel.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to approve skate park option one, the land east of Kids Kingdom, while allowing for future parking for the TC Passios building.
The board left the social media policy as adopted and will review it again at least once a year.
A member asked for a discussion of the assumed yearly tax increase, to be put on an agenda before Town Meeting.
In a joint workshop on agriculture and economic development, the chair said an Economic Development Committee will go on a future agenda, with an initial charge on the agricultural side.
The DPW director objected during public comment to a selectman's criticism at the prior meeting about stormwater and the debt exclusion.

why_it_matters: The skate park site is now chosen, and a member explained that volunteer work paid with private funds would not trigger prevailing wage, which bears on how much public money the project needs.
The planned discussion of the assumed yearly tax increase goes to how the town budget, mostly taxes, is projected, and could shape what residents are asked to approve at Town Meeting.
An Economic Development Committee and the farmers market's request to become a budget line could lead to town spending or grant applications for agriculture.
watch_next: A future Select Board agenda item creating an Economic Development Committee.
An agenda item on the assumed annual tax increase, to be held before Town Meeting.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the skate park Option 1 vote and on there being no transfers. They differ on the social media policy and Economic Development Committee decisions, the budget figures, and who attended. The main thing to know is that the dollar figures and the tax levy discussion in our minutes have no counterpart in the official minutes, and our attendee list is badly garbled.
